templates.subject: This is the first template That I Make!
templates.body:
Hi {first_name},

It’s nice to meet you! I realize we haven’t met before, so I hope you don’t mind me reaching out.
I came across your GitHub profile and your work on {repo} ({skill}).

My name is Maria, and I’m reaching out because I’m currently developing an early-stage business idea that I believe could create an opportunity for people to earn additional income without requiring a significant upfront investment.

Since the idea is still in its early stages, I’m especially interested in getting a professional perspective from someone with experience in the field. I’d really appreciate the opportunity to briefly share the concept, hear your thoughts, and learn how you see its potential, as well as any practical challenges I should consider.

If you’re available, I’d be grateful for the opportunity to have a short call or meeting at a time that works for you. I’m happy to work around your schedule.

Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope we have an opportunity to speak.

Best regards,
